[[Sigma Zeta]] is an international [[honor society]] for the [[natural science]]s, [[computer science]], and [[mathematics]].<ref name=":0" /> It was founded in 1925 at the now defunct [[Shurtleff College]].<ref name=":0" /> The society has regular chapters at baccalaureate institutions and association chapters at [[junior college]]s.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Chapters |url=https://sigmazeta.org/chapters/ |access-date=2024-12-13 |website=Sigma Zeta}}</ref>

In the following Sigma Zeta chapter list, active chapters are indicated in '''bold''' and inactive chapters and institutions in ''italics''.<ref name=":0">{{Bairds17|pages=699-700}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Chapter Roll |url=https://sigmazeta.org/chapter-roll/ |access-date=2024-12-13 |website=Sigma Zeta}}</ref>
